description: Static checks (with a type check of assets/*.js), and minifying on deploy: pages work unbuilt, as they are in the repo.

scripts.check: biome check && html-validate '*.html' && node scripts/translate.mjs --check && node scripts/types.mjs --check && tsc -b jsconfig.json --force && uvx ruff@0.17.3 check scripts && uvx ruff@0.17.3 format --check scripts
scripts.format: biome format --write && uvx ruff@0.17.3 format scripts
